claude_proposed_widenings.name: zone_object_creation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prismatic Wall creates a persistent physical barrier (wall or globe) that occupies space, has its own AC (10), and affects creatures that enter or pass through it. None of the four existing spell families (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) model a spell-created object with an AC that exists independently in the world and is traversed spatially. This requires a new family distinct from all four.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall... The wall lasts for the duration." / "the wall, which has AC 10, can be destroyed one layer at a time"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_layer_traversal
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wall has 7 ordered layers that each fire a DEX saving throw as a creature passes through, one layer at a time. This is not the existing 'phases' array on ActivationMechanics (which models sequential attack/save resolutions against a target), nor a flat area effect. The traversal is spatial and ordered: a creature must pass through all layers in sequence, each resolving independently.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When a creature reaches into or passes through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the layers. Each layer forces the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: restrained, blinded, petrified
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface Condition type is a closed string literal containing only 'prone'. Indigo layer applies Restrained (escalating to Petrified on 3 failures). The proximity aura and Violet layer apply Blinded. These three conditions are not in the type and cannot be added without widening the Condition union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition" (Indigo) / "the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition" (proximity aura) / "If it fails three times, it has the Petrified condition" (Indigo)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save in spell Effect context
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Indigo layer requires tracking 3 successes and 3 failures across successive CON saves at the end of each turn, resolving to either condition-end or Petrified. The v4 atom 'repeat_save' / 'condition_progression' exists in the taxonomy but has no representation in the surface Effect type. SpellEffect is currently 'damage | none'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the Petrified condition... The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind." (Indigo)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile in spell Effect context
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Violet layer on a failed WIS save teleports the creature to another plane (DM's choice). The v4 atom 'transport_exile' exists in the taxonomy but is not in the surface Effect discriminated union. Adding it to Effect would be a surface widening; exposing it from a multi-layer traversal structure requires the structural_widening above to land first.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM's choice)." (Violet)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: layer_destruction_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Each of the 7 layers has a unique destruction condition: specific damage thresholds of a given type (Red: 25+ cold damage; Blue: 25+ fire damage; Yellow: 60+ force damage), specific spells by name (Gust of Wind destroys Orange; Passwall destroys Green; Dispel Magic destroys Violet), or environmental effects (Bright Light from Daylight destroys Indigo). No existing surface type models per-layer destructibility with heterogeneous destruction predicates.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "which is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Cold damage" (Red) / "which is destroyed by a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind)" (Orange) / "This layer is destroyed by Dispel Magic." (Violet)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: proximity_aura trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wall triggers a CON save for any creature that moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there. This is not 'enters_area' (which fires when a creature enters an area) but a radial proximity check relative to the wall object's edge. The AnchoredTriggerMechanics events only have 'physical_contact' and 'enters_area'; neither captures a 20-ft proximity radius around an object boundary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If another creature that can see the wall moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute."
